MOHAMMED IMRAN A H Team Lead | Payments & Card Operations

Chennai, India | 9962880172 | mohammedimranimran002@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Payments and Card Operations professional with 9+ years of experience across Banking, Cards and Payments, including APAC operations and Corporate Card programmes. Experienced in card settlements, reconciliation, refunds, chargebacks, disputes, partner onboarding, UAT, production deployment and operational readiness across Visa, Mastercard, RuPay and UPI ecosystems. Strong experience coordinating regional stakeholders and driving process improvement, automation and operational efficiency across payment operations.

CORE SKILLS

Payments & Card Operations | Corporate Card Programmes | APAC Operations | Payment Implementation & Migration | UAT & Production Deployment | Operational Readiness & Cutover | BAU Handover & Transition | Stakeholder Coordination | RAID Management | Partner Onboarding | Process Improvement & Automation | Exception & Escalation Management | JIRA | Confluence | Reconciliation & Settlement | Refunds & Chargebacks | Disputes | Visa | Mastercard | RuPay | UPI

AREA OF EXPERIENCE

Card & Payment Operations | Reconciliation & Settlement | Refunds & Chargebacks | Dispute Management | Visa/Mastercard/RuPay/UPI Operations | Issuer Operations | Payment Gateway Operations | Process Automation & Continuous Improvement | MIS & Operational Reporting | KYC & AML Compliance

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TerraPay Solutions India Private Ltd | Jun 2024 – Present Team Lead – Global Payment Operations

Coordinated payment implementation activities across business, operations, technology and partner teams, covering

requirements, testing, UAT, readiness and production deployment through operational support.

Managed Corporate Card programmed across APAC markets, coordinating business, operations, technology and partner

stakeholders across implementation, testing, readiness and production activities.

Owned RAID management for assigned payment/card workstreams, tracking risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and actions

and driving mitigation, follow-up and escalation through closure.

Coordinated UAT, production readiness and cutover activities, tracking outstanding issues, stakeholder approvals and operational

dependencies through go-live.

Coordinated operational migration and transition activities, including process validation, testing, readiness tracking and resolution

of operational gaps and dependencies before transition.

Supported migration planning and handover to receiving operations teams, tracking outstanding activities, operational impacts,

documentation and support requirements through transition to BAU.

Supported post-implementation stabilization, working with operations, production and partner support teams to resolve open

issues and maintain service continuity.

Led reconciliation and settlement operations across 15 currencies, including refund reversals, partner fund posting, GL

reconciliation and compliance with Visa Issuer standards.

Streamlined reporting and reconciliation workflows through automation, reducing manual effort and accelerating exception

resolution across payment channels.

Managed partner onboarding and product demonstrations, overseeing UAT and production deployment to support smooth

integration and operational readiness.

Directed a team of 5 supporting CMS and reconciliation activities, defining KPIs and ensuring SLA/TAT adherence while coordinating

with partners and vendors.

Managed production and partner escalations, leading issue triage, root-cause analysis and resolution while driving improvements

to reduce recurring incidents.

Maintained project and operational artefacts in JIRA and Confluence, including workstream tracking, implementation

documentation, readiness materials and BAU handover documentation.

Mohammed Imran A H

M2P Fintech | Dec 2022 – Jun 2024 Associate Manager – Banking Operations

Led day-to-day reconciliation and settlement activities for NFS, RuPay, UPI and Visa Issuer transactions, including ATM and POS

transactions.

Reconciled daily settled bank reports with issuing-bank incoming funds and outgoing staged reports across Visa, Mastercard,

RuPay and UPI.

Cleared unsettled and refund cases, reconciled GL reports and published reconciliation and settlement dashboards for

stakeholders.

Handled complaints and claim settlements including chargebacks, representments, pre-arbitration and pre-compliance, with MIS

reporting as required by banking stakeholders.

Prepared customer credit/debit batch files and monthly DPI, PPI and RBI reports for Visa, RuPay, UPI and issuer programmes.

Supported reconciliation automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.

Worked with production and partner support teams to resolve operational escalations and maintain service continuity.

Led new-joiner KT and supported monthly invoice processing.

Slice | Aug 2021 – Dec 2022 Card Operations – Settlement & Chargeback

Handled daily Visa settlements, refunds and partial settlements, including reconciliation of Visa card transactions.

Managed the complete dispute process, including chargebacks, representments, pre-arbitration and pre-compliance activities.

Prepared management reports and MIS and introduced dashboards to monitor merchant cash refunds and settlement

expectations.

Supported reconciliation automation and provided KT to new joiners.

Open Financial Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bangalore | Sep 2020 – Aug 2021 Senior Executive – Operations

Managed daily operations of the card business, including settlements, reconciliations and chargeback activities.

Managed payment programmes across RuPay, M2P and Visa and handled regular reconciliation of card finances.

Managed activation and deactivation of payment gateway accounts across Visa, Mastercard, Diners, Amex, Maestro and RuPay.

Analysed operational metrics and supported customer issue resolution.

Slice IT, Bengaluru | Oct 2017 – Mar 2020 KYC Associate – Credit

Performed periodic KYC reviews on a risk-based schedule and reviewed documentation for new customer accounts.

Evaluated higher-risk accounts, analysed customer processes and escalated cases requiring additional information in line with KYC

policies.

Performed defect analysis and provided feedback to peer groups, highlighting cases requiring additional information.

Analysed customer metrics to support credit-limit decisions.

Janalakshmi Financial Services | Oct 2016 – Sep 2017 Customer Relationship Officer

Handled customer complaints and coordinated resolution activities.

Supported team operations across sales and collections.

EDUCATION

Degree / Course BBA Diploma in Professional Cookery H.S.C

S.S.L.C

Institute SIKKM Professional University Indus Shipping, Chennai Arignar Anna School Government Higher Secondary School, Chennai

Year of Passing 2025 2016 2013

2010

Mohammed Imran A H
